title: Family at California Mission Fountain, 1968 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A late-1960s black-and-white square snapshot photo showing a mother sitting with her young daughter and son on the edge of a stone fountain. They are posed in the ivy-covered courtyard of a historic Spanish colonial mission featuring four large bells mounted inside open stone arches above. The photo bears a stamp date of September 1968 along the top margin.
